purpose: Explain how canonical BRRK earns returns and why the previously frozen Stablecoin external gross-cap diagnostic reduced economics, without optimizing or changing any strategy rule.

frozen_metrics.session_win_rate: positive net-return sessions divided by nonzero net-return sessions; exact-zero tolerance=1e-15
frozen_metrics.active_session_win_rate: same definition restricted to held gross exposure > 1e-12
frozen_metrics.payoff_ratio: mean positive session return divided by absolute mean negative session return
frozen_metrics.profit_factor: sum positive session returns divided by absolute sum negative session returns
frozen_metrics.holding_cycle: a new cycle starts on any session with executed turnover > 1e-12; cycle return compounds from that session until the session before the next turnover-positive session
frozen_metrics.cycle_win_rate: positive compounded holding-cycle returns divided by nonzero holding-cycle returns
frozen_metrics.return_concentration: rank canonical daily net returns; for N in [10,20,50], report share of total log growth contributed by the N best sessions and same-horizon CAGR after setting those N session returns to zero; also report CAGR after setting the N worst session returns to zero
frozen_metrics.external_state_conditioning: assign each return session the external state computed on its immediately preceding decision date using the already-frozen D-2/D-22/D-42 Stablecoin semantics
frozen_metrics.external_path_delta: compare the already-frozen fused path with canonical baseline session by session; report fused-minus-baseline return deltas separately on baseline-positive and baseline-negative sessions
frozen_metrics.overlap: for each external state report mean canonical BRRK target gross and fraction of decision rows on which canonical gross was already at or below that state's frozen gross cap
